paragraphs: Chapter 666
Episode 169. To the Enemy's Sanctuary (4)
'A sword...?'
At a glance, Veradin's hand didn't show the calluses unique to those who wield swords.
-The junior head is impossible, Jin Runcandel.
-I'm curious as to why.
-That kid is no longer the Veradin Zipfel you knew. Now...he's almost like a newborn.
-New...born? It would be nice if you could explain it in simpler terms, Wraith Captain.
-It's just as I said. Veradin has currently lost all his knowledge, mana, habits, and memories, including language.
It was a conversation exchanged with Octavia during the first meeting of the temporary alliance just a while ago.
All of this was verified to be true by Yuria herself. At the time of the first meeting of the temporary alliance, Veradin was indeed almost incapacitated.
'In that short time... has there been a change in Veradin?'
As hard as it was to imagine a figure described as like a newborn, Veradin displayed an extremely business-like and stable attitude.
Even in his measured steps forward, a sharpness was felt and along with that, a familiar energy was detected.
'Aura...'
It was extremely faint, not even at the first level, but it was definitely an aura. Rather, the mana felt was even less than the aura.
Magic Swordsman.
The feeling that Zipfel's biogolem experiments might have been for the purpose of creating a magic swordsman had been with me for several years now.
But I didn't expect to glimpse a possible result of that through Veradin at this moment.
"Veradin Zipfel."
"Why do you call me?"
"I heard that until recently, you were in a state where you couldn't do anything with all your memories erased, but it seems your condition has suddenly improved."
"I've been able to live without the help of others for about a week now."
"Do you have any memories of Dante and me?"
Veradin stopped and turned back.
Jin was following Veradin slowly with the sealed Valeria in his arms.
He couldn't walk fast. During the five-day flight, Jin had been continuously maintaining the seal on Valeria without a moment's rest, and the same was true now.
His mana wasn't exhausted, but the mental exhaustion was too great. He was sweating.
"Many people ask about you and the Sword Emperor."
Veradin stood next to Jin and put his hand on Valeria's seal.
Then, without any effort, mana began to flow into the complex seal. It continued without Jin taking any special measures.
"I don't remember anything."
"I see."
Thanks to Veradin starting to maintain the seal, Jin was able to move with ease. Jin did not ask about Veradin's abilities.
"One thing, I've been curious about. When so many people were trying to find my memory, why did they only talk about you and the Sword Emperor, not the members of my clan?"
Their strides were becoming the same.
"What were you curious about?"

"Isn't it strange? I don't know about the Sword Emperor, but the clan you and I belong to has been nemesis for a thousand years. We had to form a temporary alliance recently, but until then, we were ready to destroy each other whenever we had the chance."
"Well, it was strange. Especially your character."
"I was strange?"
Seeing him question in surprise, I thought some of his old self might have remained. I also thought that Veradin might be joking right now.
But that was it, even without Yuria's verification, the current Veradin was not the person he knew.
"Yes. From the first time we met, you were strange."
"I'm even more curious. Can you tell me in detail?"
"No."
As Jin quickly refused, Veradin shrugged as if disappointed.
Then, after a few more minutes of walking, he casually took his hand off Valeria's seal.
"If you won't tell me, I don't see the need to do you a favor."
"What great favor? It's just a bit uncomfortable, but I can maintain the seal without you."
"Hmm."

"Besides, your action doesn't match the purpose of Zipfel opening the sanctuary. I won't fail to maintain the seal, but there's a one-in-a-million chance in the world. In that case, I'm curious about how your clan would react."
"You do have quite an annoying way of speaking as I've heard......"
Veradin again placed his hand on Valeria's seal. It could be an embarrassing situation, but he had no change in expression.
Beyond the gate, the road leading to the sanctuary had a strange landscape.
The normal hallway made of stone and various metals was getting blurrier as it went deeper.
Just like Orgal's blurry flesh.
It wasn't a sight to see in this world.
'I didn't have a separate entrance to the subspace, but at some point, I feel like the boundary of the world is starting to blur.'
Like paint being washed away, the colors and textures that made up space were leaving an afterimage.
"How much further do we have to go?"
"I can't tell."
"Measuring time directly is not a difficult task, is that also confidential?"
"No. The time to reach the sanctuary varies. It depends on how much the sanctuary welcomes our three visitors."
"So, it has as many mysteries as its grand name."
“Last time I visited, I heard it took a fortnight. That was before I lost all my memories."
"So, it could take a fortnight, but you didn't prepare any food for a reason."
"Yes, after all the traces of the hallway disappear... in the sanctuary, you don't feel hunger. Rather, the more you walk, the lighter your body feels."
Just as he said, Jin had been feeling a rapid recovery of strength since crossing the 'boundary'. His head, which had been dizzy from maintaining the seal, was also crystal clear.
Still, Jin wanted to measure his steps and calculate time, but strangely, as his body and mind became full, the concept of 'time' faded.
Even calculating roughly one second per step became difficult. Even if he counted a few times, Jin was counting one second again.
'Is it because there is a discrepancy in time between the sanctuary and the inn, like other non-spaces. It's a strange sensation.'
So they couldn't tell how far they had walked, but the two soon spotted a streak of green light in the distance.
'It's residual energy.'
It was exactly the energy they had glimpsed through Orgal's steel door. In a landscape as dim and blurry as underwater, only the residual energy was vigorously revealing its radiance.
"We're almost there."
The two, standing in front of the green energy, simultaneously reached out to it as if they had made a promise.
Then, as if a fire had been suddenly lit in the whole world, the surroundings turned blue in an instant.
It was no different from the 'sanctuary of a few hundred years ago' that Orgal showed.
A landscape like a sea shining in green, or a desert.
"Now release Hister's seal. As soon as Hister recovers, we will escape from the sanctuary."
Upon reaching the sanctuary and trying to release the seal, he felt uneasy.
What if the residual energy of the sanctuary has no effect on Valeria? What if there is no way to seal her again?
In the moment when such doubts were about to make his mind dizzy, Jin confirmed that Valeria, inside the seal, had stirred.
Valeria began to react to the residual energy of the sanctuary even before the seal was removed.
The pale seal was already turning green.
"You worry too much after coming this far."
Veradin said, as if he had seen through Jin's inner thoughts.
"Well, given that my family and yours are sworn enemies."
"There's a reason why we go so far as to open up the sanctuary to the enemy of Runcandel, to save Hister. Don't you know it better than anyone?"
"It sounds like you intend to deal with me after restoring Hister right here."
"There were quite a few who suggested doing so."
"Octavia and Kadun?"
"No, it was mostly the elders."
Jin came to the enemy's territory, even to the deepest part of the enemy, with Valeria, who was wounded, alone.
-Only I can face Rosa, so the burden feels a bit heavy. With Kinzelo, there is at least the variable of Orgal's recovery, but does Zipfel have no trump card at all?
Jin had arrived alone with Valeria, who was wounded deep in enemy territory.
-"Only I can take on Rosa, which puts quite a burden on my shoulders. With Kinzelo, at least we have the variable of Orgal's recovery, but does Zipfel have no hidden measures?"
-"I never thought I'd be glad to hear that the enemy has hidden forces. What is it? I think you have to answer this question. It's for the sake of dealing with a public enemy."
-"It's historical manipulation. However, it's a method that can never be realized without the survivor of Hister, who is your ally."
During the first meeting of the temporary alliance, Lornil had said that Zipfel could confront Rosa through 'historical manipulation'.
So, in fact, it was insane for Jin to come here now. It was a choice he would never have made if Valeria or his colleagues were not present.
He can't escape with the help of Red Owl or Mort here.
If Zipfel does not keep his promise, Jin is inevitably doomed to a desperate crisis.
"But didn't my father object directly? Aren't you curious about his reasons?"
-"Because he has to keep using me to deal with Rosa."
Zipfel and Kinzelo. They didn't want to lose him, the only chaos immune, at this point.
That's why each power's top talents directly supported Calderan's snowfield.
The only things Jin believed in as he stepped into the enemy's midst were that fact and his own power.

-"Exactly, and I felt the same way. It seems difficult for the time we can complete historical manipulation through Hister to be faster than when the monster fully awakens. At this point, you are definitely a more important card to our family than Hister."
Whether it was a lie or the truth, Veradin was speaking as if he had no reason to hide the issue of historical manipulation anymore.
-"The idea that I'm Zipfel's most important card doesn't make me feel good. If the guide was someone other than you, you would have taken a hit at this point."
Jin slowly began to unlock Valeria's seal. It wasn't because he believed everything Veradin said. He just thought it would be better to restore her and leave as planned.
-"And, Jin Runcandel."
-"What?"
-"Before I lost my memory, I made a promise with you."
-"A promise?"
-"That if you ever come to our family unannounced, I will spare you once."
-Be thankful that this is a party place.

-Heh, aren't you overreacting? I know too, that your father showed mercy to your uncle. Since it came up, I will also promise something. If you ever come unannounced to Zipfel's party, I won't harm you.
It was a conversation they had at a party before Jin became a substitute knight.
Veradin was not remembering that conversation, he was talking about the records in his not-so-old diary.
-"It even said that even if you cause a terror in our family, I will definitely save you once, so I couldn't help but be curious about my relationship with you, right?"
-"Didn't you say the old you was a strange guy? When we had that conversation, we weren't even close. We weren't even friends, to be precise."
-"Then it seems only I thought of us as friends back then. Anyway, if I say I will keep that promise now, would your guard come down a bit?"
In response to his words, Jin suppressed a bitter expression and answered like this.
-"I can't say I trust it fully, but it's not a bad story to hear."
